profiles.ends: Zero derivative at both endpoints; flat extension at endpoint Y outside the ramp domain.
profiles.supportDomain: Unique support across the union of four-column covered hexes; inner two columns are stoppable, outer two are non-stoppable ramp_shoulder with blocksGroundMove=true and blocksLineOfSight=false. Clip original Tile tops/walls inside this footprint. Only listed lower/upper shared-edge portals are open.
profiles.shoulderPresentation: D3 must visibly present the shoulder as non-traversable edge earthwork or gravel, not indistinguishable empty flat ground. The body swept-clearance region remains the same smooth support profile: no railing or protruding stones inside it. Decorations may occupy only the outer shoulder region after finite geometry establishes clearance.
profiles.logicalHeightQuantization: lowerLevel below the worldZ midpoint; upperLevel above it; no half-level state. heightLevel alone remains rule input.
profiles.turning: Use enumerated full pair poses/turns and finite profile shoulders plus horizontal platforms; no untested full-circle turning claim.
profiles.geometryStatus: D1 fixed design accepted: all 390 legal stationary pair poses and two dynamic witness routes (1295 samples,1240 conservatively bounded intervals). This is not geometry validation of all 993 graph-legal dynamic transitions; see shared geometry evidence and D3 runtime obligations.

stairs.stairSurfaceDefinition: At each riser worldZ, height increases by .09375; constant horizontal tread between consecutive risers. Before the first riser use lowerY, after the last use lowerY+.75. Profile domain is exactly the union of three covered hexes; vertical faces are the actual risers, with no hidden slope support.
stairs.geometryStatus: D1 shared true-stair dimensions fixed: three stopping platforms validated in six facings, and actual player stepping sampled with lower-foot support and no body penetration. Finite domain is the declared three-hex footprint. Subsequent D3 runtime presentation must implement the measured stepping behavior.
stairs.movingSupport: Each tested traversed pose has an actual lower foot support and no body penetration; simultaneous two-foot contact is required at the three stopping platforms, not during stepping. Subsequent D3 runtime presentation supplies foot lifting animation.
stairs.supportOwnership: The three covered hexes bind this one stair authority, including both endpoint landings, midpoint landing and true treads. Clip original Tile tops inside the footprint. No hidden slope collider or second top. WorldZ profile is shared for all facings; axial center travel is 2m although worldZ separation is sqrt(3)m.
stairs.logicalHeightQuantization: Midpoint platform remains at lowerLevel, upper platform at upperLevel; intermediate physical .375m rise is not a new rule height.
